pages.text: Several mods add the same metal. In this pack one version of each is $(thing)canonical$(): other mods' recipes now make and use that item, so they stack and match. Leftover items convert 1:1 in a crafting grid.$(br2)Full list: $(l:materials/shared_metals)Shared Metals$(/l).

$(li)$(bold)Steel$(): TFMG's. Alloyed, Create Big Cannons and Create Nuclear steel convert to it$(li)$(bold)Bronze$(): Alloyed's$(li)$(bold)Lead$(): Create Nuclear's, the only lead ore (TFMG's is off). TFMG lead converts to it

$(li)$(bold)Copper wire and spool$(): Crafts & Additions'$(li)$(bold)Sulfur dust$(): TFMG's$(li)$(bold)Salt, cocoa butter, cocoa powder$(): Create Ratatouille's$(br2)Conversion is one for one with no gain, so loops can't be farmed. Check JEI (R, U) for the recipes.

$(li)$(bold)Titanium$(): ore only on Northstar's planets, but you can make it on Earth by crushing limestone or sand into Rutile and running an assembly line$(li)$(bold)Platinum$(): a Create Propulsion ore, needed for vector thrusters

$(li)$(bold)Zinc$(): Create's metal, needed for brass. Productive Bees can make zinc and lead bees too.$(br2)Crushing ores with Create gives more metal per block. See $(l:materials/ore_doubling)Ore Doubling$(/l).
